name: trail-code-mentor
description: Perception and UI for Trail, the interruptible cursor agent: streams hover, selection, typing rhythm, document changes, saves, test runs and terminal output to the local Trail bridge and renders its notices.

trail.enabled.description: Connect to the local Trail bridge and send perception events. When off, nothing is read or sent.

trail.bridgeUrl.description: WebSocket endpoint of the Trail bridge. Only loopback hosts (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) are accepted.

trail.token.description: Bridge token. If left at the default, the token in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Trail\bridge.token (or ~/.trail/bridge.token) is tried first.

trail.readTerminal.description: Opt in to sending terminal output (via shell integration) so stack traces can be pre-diagnosed. Secrets matching common key patterns are masked first.

trail.typingIdleMs.description: Idle time after the last edit that ends a typing burst and sends the document to the code mentor.

trail.maxDocumentBytes.description: Cap on document text sent with doc_change (the bridge refuses frames over 256 KB).

trail.dwellFromHover.description: Also send a dwell event when the pointer rests on a symbol ~350 ms past the hover, so it enters the session trail.

trail.showNotices.description: Show agent-initiated notices as VS Code notifications.

trail.excludeFiles.description: Glob patterns for files Trail never reads (no hover, selection or document events).
